title: The linter check produces a stable-shape lint report and fails non-zero on any lint error
asA: operator whose project enables the elicited linter check
iWant: a lint gate whose report shape and exit-code semantic are stable across projects
soThat: downstream readers (dashboards, merge queues) can consume lint outcomes without per-project scraping

acceptanceCriteria.description: When `checkSet.linter` is true, the gate-runner runs the project-realised linter runner, captures its exit code and streams, and writes the per-gate report to `.rcf/reports/ci/lint.json` with `checkKind: "linter"`. A non-zero exit code from the runner flips the gate outcome to `failed`.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a project with `checkSet.linter: true` and a realised linter runner satisfying the runner-contract interface
acceptanceCriteria.when: a CI workflow invokes the gate-runner
acceptanceCriteria.then: a report file at `.rcf/reports/ci/lint.json` is written with `checkKind: "linter"`, and the gate outcome tracks the runner exit code
